background.text: The employer of the second Milanese period is the French crown. Louis XII's direct intervention against the Florentine demand for Leonardo's return (the unfinished Anghiari) shows his labor being treated as a matter of interstate diplomacy. The center of gravity of the period lies in anatomy, with the concentrated production of the Windsor anatomical sheets A and the collaboration with Marcantonio della Torre of Pavia reported by the tradition C ; in hydraulics on the Adda and the Martesana canal; and in the design of the Trivulzio equestrian monument. After the French collapse of 1512 Leonardo withdrew to the villa of his pupil Francesco Melzi's family on the bank of the Adda at Vaprio, where the sequences of water studies and geological observation of the Adda gorge were made. That the refuge in a political vacuum was neither a court nor a city but the country house of a noble pupil marks the shift of his late structure of protection toward personal bonds: the same bond that would, by the will of 1519, determine the survival of the manuscripts.
